desc: Read input N, M and the list of M colored cells.
Iterate through all M colored cells:
If cell `(x, y)` is Black, update `min_r[x] = max(min_r[x], y)` and `min_c[y] = max(min_c[y], x)`.
Iterate through all M colored cells again to verify consistency:
If cell `(x, y)` is Black, check if `y <= min_r[x]` and `x <= min_c[y]`. If not, return "No".
If cell `(x, y)` is White, check if `y > min_r[x]` or `x > min_c[y]`. If neither is true, return "No".
